subject: Capture causal edges from task results
description: Add a narrow causal/task outcome edge slice by extending structured task_result with explicit causal_edges. Validate allowed relations such as caused, fixed, blocked, depends_on, supports, contradicts; preserve existing task_result strictness; write accepted causal_edges as non-blocking relation-bearing context edges with origin task-result-causal. Also allow overlay.addEdge to carry relation metadata on context edges so graph-store replay/search activation can see it. Do not infer causality from prose and do not touch AST graph work.
